Augustēus , a, um, adj. Augustus,
I.of or belonging to Augustus, Augustan: “lex,” Front. Col. p. 121 Goes: “termini,” id. ib. pp. 119, 121, 122: “charta, also called regia,” Isid. Orig. 6, 10, 2 (cf. Plin. 13, 12, 23, § 74): marmor, v. 2. Augustus, II.—Hence, Augustēum , i, n., a temple built in honor of Augustus, Inscr. Orell. 642.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
